title: Prepare aead 0.6 / signature 3.0 PRs for official wolfssl-wolfcrypt
description: wolfSSL/wolfssl wrapper/rust/wolfssl-wolfcrypt (v3.0.0) is still on aead 0.5 and signature 2.2. Both bumps break its users, so ask the maintainers about versioning. Coordinate with the SLH-DSA PRs #11311/#11182. The wolfssl-rs port (69dm.2) is the reference.
